name: Roasted Spiced Carrots with Dukkah (Mixed Nut & Seed Topping)

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and trim carrots; halve lengthwise. Transfer carrots to a large baking sheet pan, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning halfway through, until carrots are golden brown and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add hazelnuts, pine nuts, sesame seeds, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds; toast, stirring frequently, until golden and fragrant, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp hazelnuts, chopped
2 tbsp pine nuts
½ tbsp sesame seeds
1 tsp coriander seeds
1 tsp cumin seeds

instructions.primary_message: Transfer toasted nuts and seeds to a food processor. Add spices, then pulse several times until nuts are finely chopped and dukkah is combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp oregano, dried
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the carrots are done, remove from the oven. Transfer to a serving platter and sprinkle with the dukkah. Enjoy!
